notification.title: Assam Rifles Technical / Tradesman Recruitment 2026
notification.howToApply: Eligible male Indian citizens must apply online through the Assam Rifles official website. Candidates must select the applicable trade, enter the required personal, domicile and category details, upload the required documents and complete the fee payment where applicable. After submission, candidates should download and retain the completed application form and fee payment proof and carry the required original documents when called for the RFID Based PST/PET.

physicalCriteria.Chest (Male): 80 cm normal and 85 cm expanded; relaxed standards of 78/83 cm and 76/81 cm apply to specified categories

faqs.question: When will the online application for Assam Rifles Technical / Tradesman Recruitment 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The online application started on 28 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online?
faqs.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 28 October 2026 at 23:59 hours.

faqs.question: What is the age limit?
faqs.answer: Most Rifleman and Havildar trades require candidates to be 18 to 23 years old as on 01 July 2026. Warrant Officer trades for Cipher, Draughtsman, Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist require 18 to 25 years.

faqs.question: What is the application fee?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs 100 for Group C posts. No fee is charged from candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Ex-Servicemen categories.
